name: Sat. 21/11 - Maria Pistolas
description: This event at Maria Pistolas in Porto features music genres such as Funk, R&B, Reggaeton, and House. It takes place on Saturday, November 21, starting at 11:55 PM and running until 6:00 AM.
longDescription:
Maria Pistolas in Porto hosts an event on Saturday, November 21, from 11:55 PM to 6:00 AM. The music selection includes Funk, R&B, Reggaeton, and House.

Tickets are available starting from €5.00 without consumption included, up to €15.00 with one drink. The venue is located at Praça de Dona Filipa de Lencastre 175, 4050-000 Porto, Portugal.
